personality: 8 Hand-Drawn / Journal LIGHT (with Sage Natural custom palette)
personality_one_liner: A calm, minimalist couple savings ledger featuring warm cream surfaces, soft sage green accents, and a tactile register feel.

spacing.rule: Generous organic rhythm with tactile rounded cards and comfortable vertical padding

do's: Use warm cream and sage tonal cards
dont's: Avoid glossy glass over pastel cream

screens.name: Auth
screens.purpose: Secure couple sign in and account registration with warm paper styling.

states.loading: Centered sage spinner on cream canvas
states.empty: Clean entry form with dual user avatars
states.error: Inline gentle error banner with clear retry action

screens.layout: Centered clean vertical stack with warm cream background, custom dual-user header, and secure username/password inputs.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Overview of joint savings, today's cash flow, and quick access to couple ledgers.

states.loading: Skeleton card pulse in sage tones
states.empty: Warm illustrated empty state inviting first shared saving entry
states.error: Connection retry prompt with offline sync indicator

screens.layout: Vertical scroll with top couple profile summary card, shared savings progress bar, quick action pills, and daily ledger list.

screens.name: Cashier
screens.purpose: Fast cash in/out recording with large keypad, category selection, and instant save.

states.empty: Select transaction type (In/Out) to begin entering amount
states.error: Amount validation prompt with haptic tap feedback

screens.layout: Header amount display, category selector pills, and responsive large-number cashier keypad fixed above bottom navigation.

screens.name: MonthlyPlanner
screens.purpose: Manage monthly household shopping items and budget items (e.g. rice, soap for Oct 2026).

states.loading: Skeleton list items for shopping categories
states.empty: Add first shopping item for the upcoming month
states.error: Failed to update monthly plan, tap to sync

screens.layout: Month selector header, budget summary card, category breakdown, and checklist of monthly household essentials with status toggles.

screens.name: LedgerDocs
screens.purpose: Documentation and receipts of where money came in and went out across manual bank accounts.
screens.layout: Filter tabs (All / In / Out / Bank), searchable list of transaction cards with category icons, photo receipt thumbnails, and source bank tags.

screens.name: BankAccounts
screens.purpose: Manual bank account management and Google Drive backup rekap.

states.empty: Add your first manual bank or cash wallet

screens.layout: List of connected manual bank accounts with current balances, Add Account button, and Google Drive backup synchronization card.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: Manage couple profile photos, partner link, and app preferences.
screens.layout: Dual circular avatar editor, couple name settings, theme preferences, and data backup options.

hero_couple.alt: Minimalist ceramic aesthetic representing calm couple savings

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement MenAbng using Expo React Native with the Sage Natural color palette (#FDFCF8 cream base, #8A9A68 sage green accents, #2C3028 dark ink text). Ensure all cashier keypad interactions trigger subtle haptics. Follow the Journal/Hand-Drawn organic radii (md=14, lg=22) and keep typography clean with Plus Jakarta Sans and Fraunces.
